P.justification: 主题（LLM自信度校准的测量方法学）与TMLR读者群契合,问题真实存在——matcher依赖性和退化分布下ECE不可靠是有价值的方法论发现。但论文反复以N=30 pilot自居,大量使用'indicative'、'not a validated bound'、'proof-of-concept'等限定语,且自述'cautionary findings that a full study must address',将自身定位为预备性工作而非完整研究,贡献的成熟度处于边缘。
P.top_weakness: 论文明确将自身框定为'pilot'和'a full study must address'的预备性工作,核心实验仅N=30,难以支撑TMLR级别的完整研究贡献定位。
P.evidence: We report a measurement methodology study—with an N=30 pilot as an illustrative example…not a validated bound…cautionary findings that a full study must address

I.top_weakness: N=30 pilot证据基础过薄,关键结论被自我标记为'illustrative''indicative'而非validated,断言的贡献范围与证据强度不匹配。
I.evidence: with an N=30 pilot as an illustrative example; initially alarming overconfidence signal...vanishes once semantically-correct answers are recognized (in-sample illustrative, not a validated bound)
